description: This file declares functions related to the Management Data Model for telco voice manager numbering plans, providing get/set methods for parameters and entry management.

methods.name: NumberingPlan_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter value for a given numbering plan context.

methods.name: NumberingPlan_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets a ULONG parameter value for a given numbering plan context.

methods.name: PrefixInfo_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Gets the count of prefix info entries.

methods.name: PrefixInfo_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a prefix info entry by index.

methods.name: PrefixInfo_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Gets a ULONG parameter value for a prefix info entry.

methods.name: PrefixInfo_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets a ULONG parameter value for a prefix info entry.

methods.name: PrefixInfo_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Gets a string parameter value for a prefix info entry.

methods.name: PrefixInfo_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for a prefix info entry.
